visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler boy in a white Adidas t-shirt stands on a wooden learning tower in a bright, modern kitchen. A woman with dark hair, wearing a grey AC/DC graphic tee, stands beside him. They are positioned in front of a grey coffee capsule machine and a white electric kettle. (2) The toddler interacts with the machine, reaching out with small hands to lift the lever while the woman guides him gently. The background shows a large refrigerator covered with family photographs and colorful magnets, illuminated by warm under-cabinet lighting. (3) The boy carefully handles a Starbucks coffee capsule, placing it into the machine's receptacle under his mother's close supervision. The camera captures a medium shot of their collaborative activity, emphasizing the child's focus and the mother's patient posture. (4) Coffee begins to drip into a small black pitcher on the counter. The boy leans in close to observe, then suddenly sneezes, causing the woman to laugh. Colorful variety-show style text overlays appear on the screen to highlight the humorous moment. (5) The boy picks up the pitcher to smell the freshly brewed coffee, looking up at the woman with a wide-eyed expression of wonder. The woman holds a blue digital thermometer, smiling down at him in the well-lit domestic setting. (6) In a concluding sequence, the boy interacts with the empty pod, offering it to the camera as if a gift. The video transitions to a title card with the boy dancing slightly, celebrating his successful completion of being a little barista.
